svg.title: A missing left-hand leaf has three ordered candidates but one fits the given interquartile range
svg.desc: Sample A has a displayed left row seven, four, h, two, one, followed by stem two. Since the left leaves decrease towards the stem and h is a digit, h can only be two, three or four. The ordered lower half is twenty-one, twenty-two, twenty plus h, twenty-four. Its median is twenty-one plus h over two. The upper-half median is thirty-two, and the overall median remains twenty-five point five for all three candidates. The table gives interquartile ranges ten, nine point five and nine seconds. A supplied interquartile range of nine therefore selects h equal four.
